\section{Safe Lua In-Engine Calculation}
Calculating factorial in Lua inside the sandbox:

\begin{luacode*}
function fact(n)
  if n == 0 then return 1 else return n * fact(n - 1) end
end
tex.print("10! = " .. fact(10))
\end{luacode*}
